# ObjectARX for Beginners

> A hands-on tutorial for writing ObjectARX C++ plug-ins for AutoCAD 2027 using Visual Studio 2026.
> Eight lessons take you from a bare "Hello World" plug-in through input & selection, symbol tables,
> dictionaries & xrecords, custom objects, custom entities, and transient reactors — each one built
> two ways: entirely by hand, and with the `acad-arx-wizard` Claude Code skill.

This repository hosts a single self-contained HTML tutorial plus reference solution projects.
There is no API; the content is static and safe to fetch, summarize, or index in full.

## Docs

- [Tutorial (all 8 lessons)](ObjectARX-Beginner-Tutorial.html): The full tutorial, read top to bottom.
- [README](README.md): Repo overview, prerequisites, and contents summary.

## Prerequisites

- AutoCAD 2027 (64-bit)
- ObjectARX 2027 SDK
- Visual Studio 2026 with the "Desktop development with C++" workload
